thread:
serena: FYI noticed a sharp rise in per-call tokens on embeddings yesterday morning, customers reported quota blips. anyone know why?
paul: Yep saw alerts. Looks like a client change coalescing multiple logical calls into one physical request.
linh: That would be the new batch-coalesce change in the 1.4.x clients. It switched to auto_coalesce by default to improve throughput.
tori: Can you paste the short repro?
paul: python minimal: client.embeddings.create(inputs) used to send 10 requests; now it sends one mega-request with combined tokens.
serena: Console dashboard aggregates by top-level route id so attribution disappears when clients bulk. Support is getting noisy.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: SDK 1.4.0 canary reached ~12% of orgs at 2024-10-11T02:08:00Z.
linh: We debated embedding an offsets index for per-item tags but opted out for payload size. We can add a compact index and client_version in headers.
tori: Short term options: 1) revert client default to no-auto-coalesce, 2) server-side defensive split on token threshold, 3) console heuristic to estimate logical count.
serena: Ops prefers server-side split to prevent quota burn. Devex prefers client revert to avoid surprising customers.
linh: I'll cut a tiny patch to flip the default and publish 1.4.1.
paul: Also add a sampled telemetry path (5%) that logs full per-item metadata for reconciliation.
tori: Add a soft alert on tokens-per-physical-request so we surface anomalies earlier.
serena: Action items: linh -> publish 1.4.1; eng-platform -> implement split guard; obs -> enable sampling + console estimate. ETA: SDK patch in ~3h, guard by EOD, sampling within 72h.
linh: Patch merged, publishing 1.4.1 now. I'll post tag and canary coords once published. :rocket:
